title: rubus thyrsoideus subsp. phyllostachys
intro: Rubus thyrsoideus subsp. phyllostachys, commonly known as a species of blackberry, is a type of plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Rubus thyrsoideus subsp. phyllostachys include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
